title: Policy Bridge for Ephemeral Prompts and Metrics Retention
creator: Amina Patel
description: Customers require fine-grained, auditable retention controls that span ephemeral prompt/response pairs, request logs, embeddings/metrics, and region-aware residency. This ticket defines a lightweight orchestration layer (Policy Bridge) that translates high-level tenant/route policies into enforcement primitives at ingestion, storage, and export time. Goals: 1) enable per-tenant and per-route TTL presets and inheritance; 2) enforce residency constraints at routing and archival; 3) produce attested evidence bundles for audits and eDiscovery; 4) expose a minimal API + console UX for rule authoring and simulation.
acceptance_criteria: Policy Bridge accepts tenant-scoped rules via API and Console UI and persists them to policy store
Rules can express per-route TTLs, sample rates for telemetry, and region constraints (home-region / deny-cross-region)
At ingestion, requests are annotated with effective retention metadata (ttl_seconds, residency, evidence_level) and honored by downstream storage/eviction jobs
Evidence export can produce a signed bundle for a tenant/route/date-range containing prompts+responses, request metadata, and retention audit trail
Simulator UI returns estimated storage delta and flagging for policy conflicts before saving
Policy evaluation has a <50ms median latency added to a request path for hosted API (cold start amortized) and is cachable per-route
Automated nightly attested export job can run for legal-hold or compliance requests and logs checksum of exported bundles in audit trail
Documentation and admin audit logs available; security review complete and KMS/HSM keys used for signing bundles
notes: We intentionally separate the Policy Bridge from storage engines to allow future backend heterogeneity (object store vs time-series DB)

Retention enforcement will be two-phased: 1) annotation-at-ingestion + soft-delete tagging for immediate SLO friendliness, 2) scheduled irrevocable purge by eviction workers to meet compliance timelines
Sampling for telemetry/metrics must be configurable per-route to avoid over-retaining high-volume telemetry that inflates cost
Regional residency is enforced via route tagging + smart routing; if no home-region is available, graceful failure modes must be defined (reject vs route-to-fallback-with-consent)
We will provide export attestations signed by a tenant-scoped subkey managed in KMS with rotation support
tradeoffs: Enforcing residency at routing adds complexity to smart router and could increase tail latency; mitigated by precomputed route->region maps and health caches
Dual-phase purge increases storage (soft-deleted artifacts retained until eviction window), but reduces risk of accidental permanent deletion while customers request evidence
Providing flexible DSL for policies increases product surface; we will start with a curated presets + guarded expression language to reduce support burden
implementation_plan: Week 1-2: PRD and data model for policy store (TTL, sample_rate, residency, evidence_level, inheritance) and API contract
Week 3-4: Console mocks and simulator prototype (PM + Design review)
Week 5-8: Engineering: policy store, ingestion annotation hook, route caching, and scheduler for eviction/export jobs
Week 9-10: Evidence packaging service (signed bundles) and audit-trail integration
Week 11-12: End-to-end QA, perf tuning, and security review + KMS integration
Week 13: Beta with 3 pilot tenants and run export drills; collect metrics and iterate
metrics_and_success_criteria: % of compliance customer requests satisfied by evidence export within SLA (target >95%)
Median added latency from policy evaluation <50ms
Reduction in average retained tokens for telemetry routes that opt-in to sampling (target 30% saving)
Number of policy conflicts surfaced by simulator (target: <2% of saved policies require manual remediation)
Security review sign-off and successful KMS key rotations in staging
ui_considerations: Console: Policy composer with presets (Strict EU Residency, 90-day prompts, 365-day logs, telemetry-sampled) and freeform mode
Simulator: preview estimated retention cost and conflict warnings before apply
Evidence export flow: ad-hoc export + scheduled attested exports with signed manifest and download link for tenant admins
Audit view: per-tenant policy change history and export access logs
risks: Misconfiguration could lead to unexpected data loss if purge jobs run with incorrect TTLs; mitigated by audit log + manual hold flags
Performance regressions in high-QPS paths if policy evaluation is not cached
Cross-region export complexity (legal vs technical) may require legal signoff per geography
